Reason: The image shows a well-defined, ovoid soft-tissue mass in the right paracardiac region that is distinct from the cardiac silhouette and diaphragm, which is a characteristic presentation of unicentric Castleman disease (hyaline vascular type) in this location. While pericardial cysts are also paracardiac, they typically appear more water-density and teardrop-shaped, whereas this solid-appearing ovoid mass aligns with the specific diagnosis provided in the options for such case reports.
